title: Lowpoly Arbitrary N-Gon Faces And Coplanar Merge
description: Support arbitrary vertex/edge count faces (n-gons) in the lowpoly mesh kernel end to end: Newell-method face normals (robust for non-planar/collinear-first-corner n-gons), ear-clipping triangulation replacing the convex-only fan (tessellate, triangulate command, UV unwrap), and a real merge_coplanar_faces + dissolve_edges implementation (currently a no-op stub) with a collinear-vertex cleanup pass. Regenerate the "Concrete Forest Left" default example mesh with all coplanar faces merged into n-gons instead of the current all-triangle tessellated output.
